note: SCAN-READY OVERRIDE, 2026-08-14. dark_2000x3.npy/gain_2000x3.npy/afe_offsets/afe_gains are this unit's own fresh self-calibration, searched today against the real hardware -- unmodified. on_counts_R_G_B here is NOT the wizard's own output -- the wizard measured against an empty gate (dark/bright references), so its own on_counts_R_G_B ([643,580,508], preserved below as flat_field_on_counts_R_G_B) is this unit's real, fresh OPEN-GATE duty. For actual film scanning, on_counts_R_G_B is overridden to docs/59-lamp-sequence-captured.md's real vendor with-film capture ([912,938,804]) -- a directly captured value off this exact unit's own wire during an actual PSI scan, not derived. pakon_scan.lamp_switch_to_scan_duty starts at the open-gate duty for the leader and switches to this with-film duty the instant film sensors report film present.
config_source: read from the captures' own sidecars (ref_dark.bin.scan.json and ref_bright.bin.scan.json), which agreed on every key in ['integration_0x82_idx6', 'lamp_pwm_N', 'line_rate_0x91', 'levels_R_G_B_Ir', 'on_counts_R_G_B', 'afe_gains', 'afe_offsets', 'fpga_ctrl', 'pixel_offset', 'pixel_height', 'dpi_base']. NOT copied from a previous calibration/README.json — these tables are valid for the setup the captures were actually taken under and nothing else.

dark_source.note: black level, empty gate, lamp off. Target band 400..4000 wire counts; a reference sitting on ADC code 0 is refused, because a clipped pedestal loses everything below it and cannot be corrected afterwards (docs/72). The AFE offsets that produce it are recorded in config.afe_offsets and are a per-DPI-base calibration output, not a constant.

bright_source.note: empty gate, lamp on, unclipped: peak 65102 of 65535 wire full scale. Target was 64000 on the 'max' statistic (the vendor's FN_bCalibrateFindLedCurrent target is 64000, and docs/15 records that its check compares the MAXIMUM pixel of an averaged CCD line, not the mean); measured level 58640. This unit's brightest sample sits 1.1102x its level, so the highest clip-free level here is about 58129.

usage: Tables are EP 0x86 wire u16. Decode: dark14=dark/4; (raw14-dark14)*gain → clamp 14-bit. Gate uses wire as-is.
formula: dark = mean down the strip; gain[:,c] = (bright-dark)[:,c].mean() / (bright-dark)[:,c] — normalised PER CHANNEL, not globally
search_note: The AFE offsets and the lamp on-counts in config were SEARCHED against this scanner's own response, not copied. Neither is recoverable from the EEPROM at any offset (docs/69 s5.4), so for any unit without a surviving Windows registry this is the only way they can exist.
